scripts.build:components: pnpm -C packages/map-web-theme-types build && pnpm -C packages/web-components build
scripts.build:components:docs: pnpm -C packages/map-web-theme-types build && pnpm -C packages/web-components build-storybook
scripts.build:base: pnpm -C packages/tools build && pnpm -C packages/map-core build && pnpm -C packages/map-service build
scripts.build:adapter:ol: pnpm run build:base && pnpm -C packages/map-adapter-ol build
scripts.build:adapter:maplibre: pnpm run build:base && pnpm -C packages/map-adapter-maplibre build
scripts.build:base:mobile: pnpm run build:adapter:maplibre && pnpm run build:storage:mmkv

scripts.build:ios: pnpm run build:base:mobile && pnpm -C packages/map-native build:ios
